name: @caisson/local-ai
description: Local-first AI edition (composition, ADR-0050 fully-commercial): composes @caisson/local-store (sqlite-vec + FTS5 RRF hybrid retrieval), @caisson/license-verify (offline Ed25519), @caisson/field-crypto (at-rest), and @caisson/kernel; adds a built two-way sync engine, an InferenceBackend port, a zero-egress privacy gate, and file-per-tenant isolation. Offline, no-lock-in — your data never leaves the device.
